verdict.rationale: Raygun has an official MCP server (raygun-probe-3) and an external API/access token system (raygun-docs-8) that could let an agent pull error data with stack traces, but there is no documented capability for filing bugs into external trackers (only repo-linking for source maps, and Slack/PagerDuty alerting, not ticket creation) and the openapi/llms.txt probes both failed, so AI-native discovery and full workflow support are unverified. missing for 10: documented MCP/API endpoints for issue triage and ticket creation, evidence of writing back to a tracker (Jira/GitHub issues), machine-readable API spec (openapi.json), and any hands-on confirmation of the MCP server's actual tool surface.
